name: armamentarium
description: Public half of the owner's Claude Code armamentarium: reasoning and verification skills that carry no personal data and work in any repository

plugins.name: think
plugins.description: Structured reasoning through the ADI cycle (abduction, deduction, induction, audit, decide) for decisions with more than one plausible answer

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Verify a finished result against a standard using a fresh sub-agent with context isolation, so it judges the artifact rather than the reasoning that produced it

plugins.name: techdoc
plugins.description: Rewrite a draft into the technical documentation register: name the kind of page, lead with what it is and who it is for, make every step verifiable, document the failure path, and strip the structural tells of generated prose

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Roles and reporting discipline for a fleet of coordinating Claude Code sessions: a lead that only coordinates, a project lead that owns one project's task list, and an IC that returns evidence rather than a verdict
